name: Morgana
title: The Dark Valkyrie
origin: Aethoria — The Shadow Reach (Citadel of Shadows)
description: A cursed sentinel of the Ebon Line. She wields a blade of pure void that consumes its user as quickly as it consumes its enemies.

passive.name: Obsidian Pulse
passive.description: Every 3rd attack deals double damage but costs 5% of Max HP. Cursed strength comes at a price.

skills.name: Void Rend
skills.description: A heavy horizontal slash that leaves a shadow trail, dealing 1.5x ATK damage and applying Shadow Burn.

skills.name: Ebon Awakening
skills.description: Fully embrace the curse. Grants invulnerability for 3 turns but drains 10% HP per turn.
